fields.comment: Kerala Flood Relief Trust is doing amazing work. The distribution of relief materials was very organized and reached the right people. Highly recommend supporting them.
Transparent and efficient organization. I donated for flood relief and could track exactly how my funds were utilized. Great work!
Wonderful experience volunteering at the orphanage. The children are well-cared for and the staff is very professional. Proud to be associated with this organization.
Priya is an exceptional volunteer! She is patient with the children, dedicated to teaching, and always punctual. We're lucky to have her support.
Priya provided excellent medical support during flood relief operations. Her first aid skills and calm demeanor were invaluable in emergency situations.
Rajesh has been a consistent donor and supporter. His contributions have helped many families during the flood crisis. Thank you!
Arun is highly reliable and efficient. He managed the logistics for relief material distribution flawlessly. Great volunteer!
Kochi Medical Relief Center provides essential healthcare services to underserved communities. Professional and compassionate team.
Anitha is a dedicated volunteer with great skills in child care. Looking forward to more collaboration.
Suresh has been generous in his donations. His support for our various campaigns is much appreciated.
